verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a REST Web API, official SDKs/libraries, cURL examples, and SMTP, but nothing about an official SendGrid CLI. cURL is a generic user-side tool and the SDKs are developer building blocks, so neither counts toward this story. An email-delivery SaaS could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies and absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
